description_en: Creates or overwrites a media asset for upload and obtains upload credentials
description_zh: 用于创建或覆盖上传媒资，并获取上传凭证
name: CreateUploadMedia

parameters.help_en: The file information, which is a JSON string. This parameter is required when you create a media asset. The Type field is required and can be set to video, audio, or image. The Name (file name), Ext (file name extension without the period), and Size (file size in bytes) fields are optional. This parameter can be omitted when you overwrite an existing media asset (Overwrite=true). If this parameter is omitted, the original media asset type and source file name extension are used
parameters.help_zh: 文件信息，JSON 字符串。新建媒资时必传，其中 Type 必填（video/audio/image），可选 Name（文件名）、Ext（扩展名，不含点号）、Size（字节数）；覆盖重传（Overwrite=true）时可省略，省略则沿用原媒资类型与源文件扩展名
parameters.name: file_info

parameters.help_en: The metadata of the media asset, which is a JSON string. This parameter is required when you create a media asset. It can contain the following fields: Title (the title; if not specified, FileInfo.Name is used), Description, CateId (the category ID), Tags (comma-separated tags), BusinessType (falls back to general if an invalid value is provided), CoverURL, DynamicMetaData (a JSON string, such as ProductionId), ReferenceId (the external reference ID), and RegisterConfig (an object that contains SearchLibName to specify the search library). This parameter can be omitted when you overwrite an existing media asset
parameters.help_zh: 媒资元信息，JSON 字符串，新建时必传。可含 Title（标题，缺省时用 FileInfo.Name 兜底）、Description、CateId（分类 ID）、Tags（逗号分隔）、BusinessType（非法值回落 general）、CoverURL、DynamicMetaData（JSON 字符串，如 ProductionId）、ReferenceId（外部关联 ID）、RegisterConfig（对象，含 SearchLibName 指定搜索库）；覆盖重传时可省略
parameters.name: media_meta_data

parameters.help_en: The custom user data, which is a JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，JSON字符串
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The entity ID. The default value is AiSaasMediaAsset. You can ignore this parameter in common calls
parameters.help_zh: 实体ID，默认AiSaasMediaAsset，一般调用可忽略
parameters.name: entity_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the upload credential. Valid values:
`STS_TOKEN`: the default value. Direct upload by using the OSS SDK.
`POST_POLICY`: form-based upload.
`PRESIGNED_URL`: pre-signed PUT URL.
`UPLOAD_TICKET`: ticket mode. A real credential is issued only when the ticket is exchanged
parameters.help_zh:
上传凭证类型：
`STS_TOKEN`（默认，OSS SDK 直传）
`POST_POLICY`（表单上传）
`PRESIGNED_URL`（预签名 PUT）
`UPLOAD_TICKET`（票据模式，换票时才签发真实凭证）
parameters.name: credential_type

parameters.help_en: The specified storage location. The format is `bucket.endpoint`. If this parameter is not specified, the default bucket selection policy is used
parameters.help_zh: 指定存储地址，格式 `bucket.endpoint`；不传按默认选桶策略选择
parameters.name: storage_location

parameters.help_en: The ID of the existing media asset. This parameter is required when Overwrite is set to true (overwrite mode). If CredentialType is set to UPLOAD_TICKET, this parameter indicates a ticket exchange. This parameter is not required in other credential modes
parameters.help_zh: 已有媒资 ID。Overwrite=true 时必填（覆盖重传）；CredentialType=UPLOAD_TICKET 时表示换票，其余凭证模式下不传
parameters.name: media_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to overwrite the existing media asset. Default value: false. If this parameter is set to true, you must specify MediaId. The original media asset is reset (old files, snapshots, and analysis results are cleared, and the status is set to uploading), and a new credential is issued as if it were the first upload
parameters.help_zh: 是否覆盖重传，默认 false。为 true 时必须传 MediaId：复位原媒资（清空旧文件/截图/分析产物并置为上传中）后按首次上传重新签发凭证
parameters.name: overwrite

parameters.help_en: The project ID. This parameter has the highest priority and is written to dynamicMetaData.ProductionId, overwriting the value with the same name in DynamicMetaData. It is automatically paired with the default folder `fd__default`. This parameter is supported only by the default entity. If you specify this parameter for a non-default entity, an `InvalidParameter` error is returned. If this parameter is not specified, `ProductionId` is obtained from the existing fallback chain
parameters.help_zh: 项目 ID。最高优先级写入 dynamicMetaData.ProductionId（覆盖 DynamicMetaData 内同名值），并自动配对默认文件夹 `fd__default`；仅默认实体支持，非默认实体传入报 `InvalidParameter`；不传时按存量兜底链取 `ProductionId`
parameters.name: project_id

FileURL.description_en: The unsigned OSS URL of the file. The format is `oss://bucket/objectKey`
FileURL.description_zh: 文件 OSS 地址（无签名），格式 `oss://bucket/objectKey`

ObjectKey.description_en: The OSS object key. The format is `yike-v1/uid segment-ws segment/date/hour/type/mediaId+random string+source suffix.file name extension`
ObjectKey.description_zh: OSS ObjectKey（`yike-v1/uid段-ws段/日期/小时/类型/mediaId+随机串+来源后缀.扩展名`）

StorageLocation.description_en: The storage location identifier. The format is `bucket.endpoint`

TicketExpiration.description_en: The expiration time of the ticket. The time is in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard. This field is returned when UPLOAD_TICKET is used
TicketExpiration.description_zh: 票据过期时间（UTC ISO8601，UPLOAD_TICKET 时返回）

UploadCredentials.description_en: The upload credentials. Some fields may be empty depending on the `CredentialType`
UploadCredentials.description_zh: 上传凭证，按 `CredentialType` 不同部分字段为空

AccessKeyId.description_en: The temporary STS `AccessKey ID`. This field is returned when `STS_TOKEN` is used

AccessKeySecret.description_en: The temporary STS AccessKey secret. This field is returned when STS_TOKEN is used
AccessKeySecret.description_zh: STS 临时 AccessKeySecret（STS_TOKEN 时返回）

Bucket.description_en: The OSS bucket. This field is returned when STS_TOKEN, POST_POLICY, or PRESIGNED_URL is used

Expiration.description_en: The expiration time of the credential. The time is in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard

Policy.description_en: The Base64-encoded PostObject policy. This field is returned when POST_POLICY is used
Policy.description_zh: PostObject Policy，Base64 编码（POST_POLICY 时返回）

PostAccessKeyId.description_en: The AccessKey ID used for the signature. This field is returned when POST_POLICY is used
PostAccessKeyId.description_zh: 签名所用 AccessKeyId（POST_POLICY 时返回）

PostEndpoint.description_en: The target endpoint for the POST request. This field is returned when POST_POLICY is used
PostEndpoint.description_zh: Post 请求目标 endpoint（POST_POLICY 时返回）

Region.description_en: The OSS region. This field is returned in all three credential modes
Region.description_zh: OSS Region（三种凭证模式均返回）

SecurityToken.description_en: The STS security token. This field is returned when STS_TOKEN is used
SecurityToken.description_zh: STS 安全令牌（STS_TOKEN 时返回）

Signature.description_en: The PostObject signature. This field is returned when POST_POLICY is used

SignedUrl.description_en: The pre-signed PUT URL. This field is returned when PRESIGNED_URL is used

UploadCredentials.title_en: 上传凭证，按CredentialType不同部分字段为空
UploadCredentials.title_zh: 上传凭证，按CredentialType不同部分字段为空

UploadTicket.description_en: The upload ticket. This field is returned when UPLOAD_TICKET is used. The ticket is a 27-character string in the format of UT1+region code+random string+check digit. A real credential is issued based on this ticket during a ticket exchange
UploadTicket.description_zh: 上传票据（UPLOAD_TICKET 时返回；27 位：UT1+地域码+随机串+校验位，换票时凭它签发真实凭证）
